Thanks for contributing to Mnemosyne! Keep PRs focused and small where you can.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link the issue it closes, e.g. "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs / tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (Docker-free unit tests)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] Integration tests run if I touched RLS, recall, or migrations (`pnpm test:integration`)
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) describing the semver impact
- [ ] Updated docs / examples if behavior or public API changed
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)

## Notes for reviewers

<!-- Anything tricky: migration ordering, isolation implications, perf, follow-ups. -->
